verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented coverage map of supported onboarding countries, local payment methods, or local-currency settlement. The only related items are a marketing line about onboarding 'global sellers' and a note that payout schedules apply to balance accounts with the same location and currency. Neither documents which countries, methods, or currencies are supported.

support.subject: As a founder, sellers can join from where they are — supported onboarding countries, local payment methods, and local-currency settlement documented as a coverage map, not discovered ticket by ticket
